title: Builder AST Schema Validation, Responsive Prop Cascade & Studio Rendering Parity

requirement.summary: Builder AST documents conform to strict schema validation with versioning, preserve responsive breakpoint overrides across reload, enforce collection rail self-exclusion, and ensure visual and behavioral parity between studio editor preview and live storefront rendering.
requirement.user_outcome: Page layouts designed in the visual builder render identically on live storefronts without layout shift or dropped widget configurations.
preconditions: AST conforming to builder schema with sections, blocks, and responsive prop bags
Standard widget catalog: Hero, ProductGrid, RichText, CollectionRail, Spacer

protected_behaviour: Builder AST validates section structure and rejects unknown or malformed widget types
Responsive prop cascade resolves mobile -> tablet -> desktop with clean fallback
ThemePreviewFrame and live storefront share exact section composition rules
Corrupted widget props render fail-safe error boundaries instead of crashing the page
forbidden_behaviour: Unsanitized widget HTML leading to stored cross-site scripting (XSS)
Dropped or corrupted responsive overrides upon saving and reloading builder document
Preview/storefront rendering divergence causing visual discrepancy

adversarial_checks.mutation_description: Omit breakpoint overrides during builder document serialization
adversarial_checks.expected_failure_snippet: expected mobile override to be preserved

adversarial_checks.mutation_description: Throw unhandled exception on malformed widget JSON
